recommendation: Keep the source fix. No further core FHIR action is needed for FHIR-43357 unless the work group later reopens the broader question of allowing DeviceMetric directly in Observation.subject.
issue_request: FHIR-43357 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. Although the submitted request asked to allow Observation.subject to reference DeviceMetric, the final resolution chose to clarify Observation.focus: the device remains the subject, the DeviceMetric is the focus, and the observing device is captured in Observation.device.
initial_application: Prior commits bec50cdfef6eccfa3ed3a0de2ebc6d630641cd88 and 8e8cc5d46abce6d51e0c9831a1936af36cc63746 edited Observation.focus for FHIR-43357, changing patient-of-record to subject-of-record and adding examples. The application was incomplete because the definition still described the focus as associated with the patient, omitted the approved implanted-device example, and narrowed the device-metric example to a patient-attached device.
additional_context: The #devices Zulip thread that led to the Jira discussed ambiguity among Observation.subject, Observation.device, and DeviceMetric for device settings and calibration. OO minutes on 2024-03-05 recorded the action as adding DeviceMetric rationale to Observation.focus, and Jira comments show both Devices and OO accepted the focus-based approach. Observation is active/normative in source/fhir.ini and Device/DeviceMetric are active approved resources. FHIR-50017 later added a formal example for this same pattern and already has its own Issue-Reconcile-Key audit commit on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Changed source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml so Observation.focus uses the approved subject-general definition, restores the implanted-device example, and states the device-settings pattern as device subject, DeviceMetric focus, and observing device in .device. No DeviceMetric target was added to Observation.subject because that would contradict the approved modified resolution.
source_changes: source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml: replaced the residual patient-centric Observation.focus definition with the approved subject-general definition and aligned the comment examples with the final device/DeviceMetric focus resolution.

related_jiras.note: Follow-on Applied issue added a formal Observation example for the same DeviceMetric-as-focus guidance and is already represented on the combined branch by commit b849542f6eb36d1496b51145efcece8a9b08425d.
